limits: The two-observed-substitution minimum is conditional on the fixed 98-position lexical candidate and the declared one-duplicate-group/one-final-A/five-loss source model.
Both five-loss geometries and all four identical-group/end-A origins are retained: eight tied maps give the same completed ciphertext, with 85 or 84 primary fixed labels.
Printed dashes and the invalid O-like glyph are ten existing source masks, not unlocated historical losses. The five added coordinates are counted separately.
The readable Rumaen. is the literal abbreviation RUMAEN; no extra transmitted letters are supplied in its display.
The printed receipt date and originating-time field are retained. The phrase 24 STUNDEN VOR DER WAFFENSTRECKUNG is not converted into a specific calendar deadline.
